title: Political Engine
description:
Political Engine 0.6.5 - Experimental release
AI-driven political correspondence, diplomacy and warfare for SkyrimNet. Exchange letters with jarls, negotiate trade and peace, command troops, and manage territories, resources and buildings through an interactive campaign map.
Built for Skyrim SE 1.6.1170 and SkyrimNet Beta25 and later. English UI with an optional Russian patch.
Continuation of Political Letters: legacy plugin names are preserved for save compatibility. Back up your save before updating.
Install the base archive first, then the Russian patch if needed.
author: sixteenth
changelog:
New in 0.6.6

### Performance and stuttering
- Numerous changes have been made to the logic for saving and updating information; 
_previously, this had caused frequent, brief freezes on some systems._
- Closed interfaces no longer build map snapshots. Retrying a deferred offer does not recalculate the entire campaign.
- Fixed Papyrus array checks, repeated command resets, and unnecessary updates for idle troops.
_Thanks for your advice, PhospheneOverdrive_

### Relationships and diplomacy
- Fixed causes of repeated assessments of unchanged relationship history.
- Improved history fingerprinting and preserved assessment retry/cooldown state across saves.
- Fixed UTF-8 explanation-length handling, including Cyrillic text.
- Clarified the distinction between personal affection, reputation, rank, and political authority.
- Authority-transfer, territorial-concession, and puppet-rule actions now use JobJarlFaction for eligibility. Actual authority and ownership checks remain enforced during execution.

### Trade and NPC construction
- Added an explicit trade-action format specifying the resource, daily quantity, price per unit, and delivery direction.
- Up to four agreed trade terms can be submitted through one action and player confirmation.
- Improved JSON validation and support for opposite-direction deliveries of the same resource.
- NPC rulers receive economically motivated negotiation opportunities based on stock, demand, treasury funds, and relationships.
- Persistent trade routes require a proposal, a reply, and validated acceptance. Old conversations do not retroactively create agreements.
- NPC construction AI (not LLM) considers economic and military needs while reserving development funds and materials.
- Buildings consume actual gold, resources, and action points.

and more, check 0.6.61 and 0.6.6 changelogs on GitHub
